about: Senior Backend Software Engineer with an infrastructure background, focused on distributed systems, solution design and production reliability.

Experience modernizing services, optimizing data processing and resolving production issues with Java, Go, Node.js and Spring Boot. Current work includes cross-service solution design and the creation of reusable agent skills with Cursor and Claude Code.
Creator of Makai, a SaaS platform for water sports schools, with responsibility for architecture, backend, infrastructure, integrations and product evolution.

cit.context: CI&T is a global technology services company. The project for AB InBev focuses on backend services and distributed systems.

senior.title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Lead solution design for cross-service features, defining service responsibilities, integrations and end-to-end flows.
Drive product-level technical decisions across backend services, balancing maintainability, reliability and performance.
Create reusable agent skills and workflows with Cursor and Claude Code to support AI-assisted development.

software-engineer.title: Software Engineer
description: Moved business logic into MongoDB aggregation pipelines, improving processing efficiency and reducing database and application resource use.
Built an internal streaming CSV library to resolve OutOfMemoryError failures and reduce memory consumption during file processing.
Automated data pipelines to replace manual operations.
Diagnosed and resolved critical production incidents through performance testing, observability and collaboration.

boavista.context: Boavista Tecnologia develops financial reconciliation software connecting payment providers, banks and ERP systems.

junior.title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Built a payment-file processing module for a new card operator, improving file-processing performance.
Resolved memory leaks through stream processing to stabilize production workloads.
Migrated core endpoints from a JSF monolith to Spring Boot services, applying domain-driven design principles.

trainee.title: Trainee Software Engineer
description: Contributed to system modernization by migrating an API from Java 8 to Java 17.
Created a deployment system to support Java 17, improving maintainability.
Developed responsive interfaces using React and Angular.

qualyvinil.context: Qualyvinil Tintas is a Brazilian manufacturer of paints, coatings and waterproofing products for the construction industry.

analyst.title: Infrastructure Analyst
description: Administered servers, network infrastructure and backup routines, including switches, Cisco access points and TrueNAS storage.
Managed Fortinet firewalls, VPN connectivity and user access across Active Directory and Google Workspace.
Maintained IT assets and workstations, providing technical support and managing service requests through GLPI.

junior.title: Junior Infrastructure Analyst
description: Supported Windows server administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and backup routines.
Assisted with network maintenance and file storage management.
Provided technical support to users and helped maintain the availability of internal IT services.

intern.title: IT Intern
description: Provided technical support, troubleshooting hardware and software issues and maintaining workstations.
Created user accounts in Active Directory, Google Workspace and ERP systems.
Logged and tracked support requests through GLPI.
